description: This file defines the PimModuleController class within the OrangeHRM PIM module. The controller inherits from AbstractModuleController and implements a handle method that redirects to the default PIM module path.

classes.name: PimModuleController
classes.description: Controller class for handling PIM module requests, providing a default redirect to the PIM module's home page.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the request by obtaining the default PIM module path and redirecting to it.
